'''Admiral_Sjet Crazy Impetus''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Admiral_Sjet]]
* '''Published:''' 12 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Holotable|ANH-D-imperialholotable.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Imperial Holotable
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Imperial Holotable Admiral_Sjet DS.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Although it is unorthodox, it actually works.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Now, FIrst Off, It looks like it wont work. Here's How Its designed:

First Turn: Before You Activate, Pull Back Door and Rendili with your starting cards. Then Pull the Endor Docking Bay if possible. (Any Docking Bay Will Do Actually). Deploy a quick victory to rendili (Assuming your not up against a WYS or Hidden Base Deck). If you have a dejarik, deploy it.

Every Turn After that, its jsut basically a preventative deck. Control & Set for Stun can cancel soem of their actions. Celebrations are not really a problem with Masterful Move(nor is Mantellian Savrip which is really a pain). The Dejariks have some defensive things for me if i ever get caught in a bnind (Ghhhk is sooooo great). Against some of those Rep decks, Monnok works wonders. The Emperor is in (besides my lack of a real one) becuase he can have some special benefits for my destiny manipulation with Sim Aloo and Janus. The Victories are loss fodder, as losing one from hand for force drains or assorted things allows you to retrieve them next turn. Rune Hakko can prevent some attrition (if i guess right) to my attrition vulnerable characters. And best of all, CHief Retwin is a godsend. Plop him there right at the heart of opponents force drains (just make sure chewie is far away).

Try it, its actually quite fun.
